page.overview:
Who is Mummy?

Mummy is a sorcerer who joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi.

Mummy is a wrinkled man, with bandages covering the sides of his face, making an X in the middle. His head is decorated with feathers. His hands are also wrapped in bandages, and he wears a fur covering, most likely made of an animal hide.

When Cavendish fell asleep, Mummy became very scared, since he knew that Hakuba would attack.

Mummy has a sense of honor, as he choose to lay his life on the line to protect Luffy from Doflamingo long enough to buy the pirate enough time to defeat the Warlord.
